subject: Vendor enrollment, PO acknowledgement requirements, and remit instructions
messages:
From: Olga Sutherland <olga.sutherland@clearmark.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@clearmark.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment & PO acknowledgement requirements

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for the call this morning — excited to get Redwood set up in Clearmark so POs and invoices can flow cleanly. To get you fully enrolled and avoid payment delays, AP needs the items below completed in the vendor portal and a quick confirmation from your side about how you handle PO acceptance.

Required for portal enrollment (please attach to the form):
- Legal company name and DBA (exact as on tax forms)
- US TIN / EIN or EU VAT number (W-9 for US vendors, VAT certificate for EU)
- Bank remit details (ACH/CAD/IBAN as applicable) + voided check or bank letter
- Primary AP contact + email and remit address for payments
- A sample invoice PDF (we use this to validate automated parsing)

PO acceptance policy: Clearmark requires an explicit acknowledgement for any PO > $5,000. Acceptable acknowledgements are: a) portal acceptance (recommended), b) EDI 855, or c) a signed acknowledgement PDF that references the PO number. If you plan to rely on automatic matching (invoice PO number + itemized lines), please confirm your invoice formatting so our parser can validate.

Payment terms & timeline: standard is Net 45 from receipt of validated invoice. Our portal supports early-pay programs; if you wish to opt into early pay, we need pricing for discount tiers. Please note that payments will be issued by ACH to the verified remit account on file.

I attached the Clearmark vendor enrollment form and step-by-step portal guide for reference. Once you submit the portal form, allow up to 5 business days for supplier verification.

Documents attached: clearmark_vendor_enrollment_form.pdf, portal_onboarding_steps.docx

Best,
Olga Sutherland

olga.sutherland@clearmark.com

Hi Olga — thanks for the clear checklist, we can get this completed this week. A few quick clarifying questions so we set expectations internally: 

1) PO acceptance: when you say "portal acceptance," is the portal acknowledgment considered the canonical acceptance (i.e., no signed PDF needed)? Or do you also require an inbound EDI 855 for customers who are EDI-enabled?

2) Invoice parsing: can you share the specific invoice fields your parser requires (PO number location, line item description max length, tax/VAT line position)? We can adjust our sample invoice to maintain a perfect match and avoid matching exceptions.

3) Remit formatting: do you require ACH routing+account only, or full bank address + SWIFT for cross-border?

4) Payment terms: Redwood preference is Net 30; would Clearmark consider Net 30 for SaaS/invoice line items billed monthly, or do you standardize Net 45 across vendor type? Any possibility for a Net 30 for subscriptions?

Action plan from our side: Ben will prepare W-9 and bank verification, Marissa will upload the sample invoice and coordinate portal submission. We aim to submit everything by EOD Thursday 7/23.

Attaching a draft sample invoice for your parsing team: sample_invoice_redwood.pdf (attached).

Thanks — Hannah

From: Olga Sutherland <olga.sutherland@clearmark.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@clearmark.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & PO acknowledgement requirements

Hannah — quick answers below, copied AP for visibility.

1) Portal acceptance is canonical. If you accept via the portal it satisfies our PO acceptance requirement and triggers automated matching. EDI 855 is only required if you are set up for EDI; it's not mandatory.

2) Parser requirements (high level):
- PO number must be on the first page, labeled "PO#" or "Purchase Order"
- Invoice line items must include a short product/service code (max 40 chars) and unit price; totals must include tax line separately.
- If VAT is present, include VAT registration number on the header; indicate whether reverse-charge applies.

3) Remit formatting: for domestic ACH provide routing + account + account type. For cross-border we need IBAN + SWIFT plus beneficiary address.

4) Terms: Clearmark standard is Net 45 for new vendors. For subscription/software we can approve Net 30 with a commercial approval (requires sign-off from Sourcing). If you want us to consider Net 30 for Redwood subscription invoices, submit a short justification (volume forecast + reason) and we'll review.

Portal link: https://portal.clearmark.com/vendor-onboard/step1
Enrollment DocuSign (signature for payment set-up): https://docusign.com/clearmark/ENROLL/abc123

Attached: portal_onboarding_steps.docx

Olga
